slowdown.note: Original co-sponsor (not her own statement) of H.R. 10538, the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act of 2026, whose Section 8 ('Pause on development of advanced artificial intelligence') pauses advanced AI until a new federal AI department issues rules; a pause for safety reasons counts as yes here. No statement of her own found.

pause.note: Original co-sponsor of H.R. 10538; the bill's pause on advanced AI lasts only until the new federal department issues rules, i.e. it is conditional on safety rules, which the rubric treats as mixed. No statement of her own found.

intl.note: H.R. 10538 directs pursuit of international agreements to prevent artificial superintelligence but (per other project files that read Section 15) does not name China or talks with China on pacing; no statement of her own found.

rsi.note: Original co-sponsor of H.R. 10538 (not her own statement). Its Section 3(6) defines 'superintelligence precursor characteristics' to include 'The capacity to automate or greatly accelerate the process of artificial intelligence research and development' and 'The capacity to independently modify or enhance its own functions', and the bill prohibits systems with such characteristics (Section 9(a), as read in other project files; the prohibition section was not re-read this run).
